items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage was $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The productivity pilot’s 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal lift; evaluation is empty. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement, attribution reconciliation, and bounded evidence work. Minimum measurement: period-aligned attributable revenue by site/content/tracking ID; reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment-cost ledger; approved budget limits; and a defined learning outcome with cost-to-learn threshold.
